draft.plain:
Our approach
- Dynamic Media with OpenAPI lets Sites authors use approved assets from a remote AEM Assets environment in the Page Editor (remote assets in Content Fragments work on AEM 6.5, not on AEM as a Cloud Service); Adobe recommends it over the older Connected Assets.
- Authors place brand-approved images from the DAM onto pages built with the Image v3 and Teaser v2 components (other components need custom work), and changes to approved assets reach the live site without re-uploading.

What we would do
- We will set the asset delivery repository and IMS client variables in Cloud Manager, configure the Image v3 component and HTTPS, and confirm authors can pick remote assets.
- We will add users to the Admin Console, create user groups and attach the AEM Assets product profiles, and confirm the Cloud Manager program and environments for the DAM.

After launch
- Each month we will review asset reports on usage and sharing, tidy metadata and tags, update processing profiles and manage user access.

Sources
- Experience League: Integrate remote AEM Assets with AEM Sites: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-manager-cloud-service/content/assets/dynamicmedia/dynamic-media-open-apis/integrate-remote-approved-assets-with-sites

Our approach
- Dynamic Media with OpenAPI lets Sites authors use approved assets from a remote AEM Assets environment in the Page Editor (remote assets in Content Fragments work on AEM 6.5, not on AEM as a Cloud Service); Adobe recommends it over the older Connected Assets.
- Authors place brand-approved images from the DAM onto pages built with the Image v3 and Teaser v2 components (other components need custom work), and changes to approved assets reach the live site without re-uploading.

What we would do
- We will set the asset delivery repository and IMS client variables in Cloud Manager, configure the Image v3 component and HTTPS, and confirm authors can pick remote assets.
- We will add users to the Admin Console, create user groups and attach the AEM Assets product profiles, and confirm the Cloud Manager program and environments for the DAM.

After launch
- Each month we will review asset reports on usage and sharing, tidy metadata and tags, update processing profiles and manage user access.

composeAnyPile.plain:
Our approach
- We would deliver this with Edge Delivery Services.

What we would do
- We will assess the current sites, vendors and content debt; rationalize duplicated components and templates; decide Edge Delivery versus traditional AEM for the agreed page set; and set the target architecture, integrations and governance model with your executives.
- We will turn Brand Visibility findings and your search strategy into the site plan and information architecture; design and build the block library and page templates on Edge Delivery; set up authoring, the CDN route (Adobe's managed CDN or your own, confirmed in discovery) and the agreed integrations; build the agreed pages; and set up Brand Visibility's Optimize at Edge routing on that CDN.
- We will map the current site to the new one; migrate the agreed pages into Edge Delivery documents and blocks; carry over or rewrite titles, descriptions, headings and structured data; set up redirects, bulk metadata and sitemaps; run crawl, link and Lighthouse checks before launch.
- We will run the go-live checklist, cut over DNS and the CDN, verify Brand Visibility, analytics, redirects and forms on the live site, and support your team for two weeks after launch.

Sources
- Experience League: Edge Delivery Services overview: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-manager-cloud-service/content/edge-delivery/overview
- Optimize at Edge | Adobe Brand Visibility: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/brand-visibility/using/resources/optimize-at-edge/overview
- Optimize at Edge - AEM Cloud Service Managed CDN (Fastly) | Adobe Brand Visibility: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/brand-visibility/using/resources/optimize-at-edge/aemcs-managed-cdn
- Adobe Edge Delivery docs: go-live checklist: https://www.aem.live/docs/go-live-checklist
